Vs.

full_judgment: 8. The averments made in the writ petitions in support of the relief sought, in short, are that petition No. 1, i.e. respondent No. 1 in the appeals, a Co-operative Society, members whereof were refugees, was registered in 1951 for the welfare of its members, the Mohazir, by way of providing residential accommodation and ill 1952 the Society applied to the Government for allotting lands for the construction of residential accommodation of the Mohazir Members of the Society and thereupon Government allotted 25 acres of land from the land which was earlier acquired by the Government and delivered possession thereof in July, 1952. The Government by a deed of conveyance of October 1956, registered in November, 1956 conveyed the land for a consideration of Taka 38,047. The Society got the land so conveyed by the Government recorded in its name in SA Khatian No.2 and that was paying Government Revenue regularly. The Society also acquired 6.97 acres of land from the Government. While the society was in possession of the land got from the Government by deed of conveyance of October, 1956, the Building Research. Institute (BRI, later on HBRI) in 1962 forcibly entered into some portion of the land of the Society and started construction of building.
